about: Reads the checking student's own Dojo Cloud subscription through the portal API of the dojo-cloud module (CLOUD_API_URL, CLOUD_CHECK_TOKEN). Reads only: the service never creates, changes or deletes a cloud resource. The account is always the checking student (the verbs take no user argument), so a check can only see that student's own container groups (overview scope=mine), Policy blade and activity log.
account: Every verb takes an optional account, written {user} in a catalog: it only states (and makes the validator see) that the check reads the checking student's own subscription; any other value fails the check.

cloud_containers.does: looks at the student's own container groups that carry every tag in tags and are in state (default Running, `any` for all): each must have a site label starting with name_prefix, be in one of locations and carry every key of require_tags; every one of labels must be among them; how many there are must be within min (default 1) and max (default unlimited). max: 0 with state any is the 'nothing left' check

cloud_policy.does: looks at the student's own Dojo Cloud Policy objects of one kind (assignment, the default; definition; set; exemption) from their Policy blade and keeps those that pass every filter given (names and display names compare case-insensitively; scope_suffix: the assignment's scope ends with it; effect: the literal effect of the assigned definition; rule_text: every string appears in the rule JSON of the definition or set (an assignment's: the one it assigns); parameters: that rule declares these parameters; noncompliant_*/exempt_min/noncompliant_resource: the stored compliance counts and failing resource names of an assignment; exemption {category?, expires_within_days?}: an unexpired exemption points at the assignment; refused: true, the student's activity log holds a write refused (RequestDisallowedByPolicy) by that assignment; an exemption's category, expires_within_days and active (default true for exemptions)). same_definition: true counts only the largest group of matching assignments that share one definition. How many are left must be within min (default 1) and max
